## Privacy checklist

- [ ] No user content (saved items, journal text, drawings) in logs, `console.*`, error messages or telemetry
- [ ] No user content in analytics events (enum-only props via the allowlist adapter)
- [ ] No user content in URLs, query strings or route params
- [ ] All persistence goes through `src/lib/storage/repository.ts`
- [ ] No new third-party network requests
- [ ] Simulated features keep their `SimulatedBadge`
- [ ] New survivor-facing copy is tagged `needs-founder-approval`; sensitive guidance is not machine-translated
